name: TC-464: finalise refuses to move money without a final price, to comp without a reason, with a line in no package, and to invoice a tenant with no credit
description: Both doors HQ has — POST /finalise (the dialog's) and the old per-line /fulfil, which now delegates to finalise — refuse a charged line with no final price (400 FINAL_PRICE_REQUIRED) and a comp with no reason (400 COMP_REASON_REQUIRED); finalise also refuses a set whose packages do not hold every line exactly once (400 PACKAGE_MISMATCH). Nothing moves: the line stays PROOF_READY with no charge. Invoicing a tenant with no credit is refused at placement (409 TERM_UNAVAILABLE).
